DML.SELECT: SELECT location_id as "id", location_type_id as "locationTypeId", lane as "lane", alias as "alias", description as "description", lat as "lat", lon as "lon", coordinates as "coordinates", auto_route as "autoRoute", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.locations WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.locations (location_id, location_type_id, alias, lane, description, lat, lon, coordinates, auto_route, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id=getNextId{'conf.locations'$'location_id'}, :locationTypeId, :alias, :lane, :description, :lat, :lon, :coordinates, :autoRoute, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.locations SET location_type_id = :locationTypeId, lane = :lane, alias = :alias, description = :description, lat = :lat, lon = :lon, coordinates = :coordinates, auto_route = :autoRoute, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE location_id = :id
